programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of science experiments with Meekah! First, she visits the Glazer Children's Museum, where she plays a fun game of sink or float, serves customers in the play restaurants and builds a fort, all while counting! Then, Blippi and Meekah visit the Ontario Science Centre to learn about gravity and electricity. They build a rollercoaster, see water react to music and even see a Hot Air Balloon!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun day at Billy Beez indoor playground with Meekah! She is visiting a playground that Blippi loves to visit, and as it's her first time, Blippi has left surprise items in her jam pack for her to play with! Meekah just needs to find where they fit best. While visiting, she also plays in Honeycomb Village, where she realizes that there are many occupations needed for a town to run smoothly!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are on the case, solving the biggest mysteries in town! When Aunt Augustine's new necklace is stolen, Detective Mila and Morphle find clues to track down the culprits. Then, Winston and the Bandits steal a time machine and use it to go to the future! Mila and Morphle must follow them to get it back. The mysteries continue as the Bandits steal Morphle and the friends must find him, and a body swap device causes a confusing mix-up!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Pogo wants to go skydiving with Newt, but she doesn't want to go. He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Have a giant Adventurous August! Help the Oddbods shrink a giant Zee back to normal size, join Jeff's obsessive quest to find out who stole his straw, and watch as Newt agrees to go skydiving to complete her sticker collection!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Syd takes on a new role as the backyard mail carrier, but his haste leads to a series of comical package mix-ups that accidentally l and him three dates on the same night! While Syd juggles his romantic predicament, the rest of the team faces a crisis of their own. They find a key Shrinkinator part, but at the same moment, Willow and Syd's bionics begin to dangerously malfunction, forcing them to choose between the mission and their own safety.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Willow starts acting secretive and skipping her duties, the rest of the team gets worried and hires a detective to spy on her. Their investigation leads to a shocking revelation: Willow has been secretly mentoring their friend Chowser through his amazing transformation into a butterfly! The team must quickly adapt to Chowser's new, winged form as they work together on their latest mission to save a group of ants.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The discovery of a fresh pizza sparks a massive race across the yard, with every bug competing for a slice. But after the race, the Insectibles are accused of cheating! They soon discover the 'Defraudibles,' a team of lookalikes, are ruining their good name. To clear their reputation, the real Insectibles must challenge their doppelgangers to a series of carnival-style games to finally prove who the true heroes of the yard are.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. Then, Slick enlists Bubbles as his dance partner for an upcoming competition but is horrified to realize that she's the worst dancer ever! How will he get out of this commitment? Finally, Slick recruits Newt to be his assistant for his latest ambition: to be a great magician!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Kick off an out-of-this-world Adventurous August! Help Bubbles investigate a cow-stealing UFO, rescue Newt from a mysterious spaceship, and figure out who the real aliens are. It's a cosmic quest full of mystery and fun!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Find the colors of Adventurous August! Join Meekah on a hunt to fill her Rainbow Bingo card at a fun play place. Then, learn all about her daily routines that help prepare for a day of adventure and a good night's sleep.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she gets creative with paint and cake! First, she visits the Paint Place in New York City, where she creates mixed media art inspired by the city skyline using materials like paint, foam and cotton balls. Then, Meekah puts on her baker's hat to decorate a friendship cake for Blippi! She learns about primary colors by mixing them to make secondary colors and cuts out different shapes to decorate her cake with.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an amazing indoor playtime adventure at three different fun locations! First, he plays around in Giggle Jungle, where he helps us learn about lots of different colors in a bright and colorful play park! Then, he visits Fidgets Indoor Playground, where he skips along while learning movement verbs like crawl, run and roll! The fun ends at Juzplay indoor playground, where kids will learn colors, shapes and so much more!

programme.title: Blippi: Specials
programme.desc: Blippi heads to his tent at the San Diego Zoo for a night under the stars. With his book of bedtime stories in hand, Blippi learns all about wild animals and what it means to be nocturnal. It's a dream come true to spend a night at the zoo. Grab your night vision goggles and come along!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are busy counting dinos and catching intruders! First, Park Rangers Maddie and Zoey go on a T-Rex Ranch adventure to count all the Dimetrodons Dinosaurs. Can they check them all safely? Then, Park Ranger Darren accidentally spills coffee on his computer, causing all the park cameras to go down! Meanwhile, a clever intruder sneaks into the park, using cookies as a distraction to bypass security.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Dino Master has made his evil return to T-Rex Ranch! When a mysterious dino egg appears at the Ranch, the conflicted Park Rangers decide to keep it safe after the Dino Master threatens to steal it. But his evil return continues! Asher's decision to rebuild the Dino Master's 'Dino Eye' gadget has terrible consequences when the Dino Master returns as a hologram to control his mind.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are trying out some fun new games and cool gadgets! First, Orson, Max and Asher try out a new gadget, the Dino Freeze Ray, from the Dino Master's gadget closet, but the results are a little cooler than they expected! Then, Park Rangers Asher and Wyatt introduce Orson to Spinni-Golf, their new game whose only object is to have fun. Plus, Bella has a hard time figuring out Maisie's new Park Ranger Achievement Badge challenge.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Embark on an up-and-down adventure for August! Explore an imagination museum with Blippi to climb jungle gyms and learn all about gravity. Then, get creative and use blocks to build an entire miniature town from your imagination.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for an exciting day at the fire station! He gets a special tour from a real firefighter, who shows him all the different parts of a firetruck, from the ladder to the siren. Blippi learns about the important equipment firefighters use and what it takes to be a community hero. It's a fun and educational look into the world of firefighting.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Slick sees Bubbles' talent for invention and decides he wants in on it, too. But after several failures, he takes a shortcut and 'borrows' one of her ideas, to disastrous effect! Then, Pogo makes himself homeless while playing a reckless game and is kindly taken in by Fuse. But it's not long before his prank-playing becomes insufferable. Plus, Bubbles discovers a possibly cursed ancient artifact.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Joey and Boo are a pair of losers when their search for food goes wrong. They battle a fly for a pear, get stuck in jelly and ride an out-of-control meatball. They also get trapped inside a worm, get stuck in earwax and deal with a leaky tap. No matter what they do, their simple tasks turn into wild, chaotic adventures.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10

programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi has so many buddies that he loves! There's Meekah, and TABBS, and DBO and all of the friends he meets on his adventures. Blippi invites his buddies at home to join him in remembering some of his favorite moments spent with friends. Awwww!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about his love for construction adventures. Countdown with him to number 1!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's a big day of teamwork and fixes at Gecko's Garage! When the Mechanicals accidentally injure Gecko's foot, they must learn the value of teamwork to finish repairing Bobby the Bus by themselves. Then, when Green Mechanical gets stressed, Gecko teaches her mindfulness tips to calm down. The teamwork continues as Gecko helps his rival, Mr. Weasel, fix an engine with a clean electric one, and the whole crew works together to repair Trevor the Tractor's giant gears!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: The ultimate rivalry between Gecko and Mr. Weasel heats up! After a big rainstorm, Weasel challenges Gecko to a head-to-head car wash competition. Then, Weasel decides he wants a Mechanical of his own, so he hatches a scheme to try and steal Gecko's secret plans! The rivalry continues as Weasel tries to show off his new sports car but gets stuck, and his automated car wash mistakes Weasel for his car!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a sense-ational journey! He visits a garden to discover his five senses, exploring the flavors of fruit and colors of flowers. His nature-filled day continues at a gorgeous greenhouse where he plants a seed and learns how water, nutrition and sunlight help plants grow. He names all the colors and learns about flowers, picking a beautiful bouquet.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi has a day full of adventure and fun! First he joins his Brave Wilderness friend Mark Vins to explore a vibrant rainforest in Costa Rica, searching for frogs and collecting tadpoles from a pond. Afterwards it's time for an under-the-sea foam party with Meekah, complete with imaginary water, hide-and-seek with a crab and a big dance party with bubbles.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Zee is zapped by an impatient Bubbles who is tired of his sluggishness. He soon finds himself sped up, but with some unintended side effects! Then, Fuse discovers his long-lost teddy bear, Mr. Snuffles, but as soon as he is found, he is lost again! Fuse goes to extreme lengths to find his bear. Finally, Fuse accidentally breaks Bubbles' totem pole and tries to cover it up.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Free Movies is a 24/7 FAST channel offering a wide range of Hollywood films, including thrillers, dramas, romances, and comedies. Enjoy nonstop cinematic entertainment with Free Movies.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American immigrants Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelin's International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa

programme.title: Come Out Fighting

programme.title: Georgia + Hong Kong
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: South Korea + Spain
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: ISTANBUL: WHERE EMPIRES MEET THE FUTURE
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the vibrant crossroads of Istanbul, uncovering how ancient empires and modern innovation collide to shape the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins with the new direct flight path from Colorado to Istanbul, a gateway to what Turkish Airlines Chairman Ahmet Bolat calls the 'beginning of civilization and culture.' From their base at the Shangri-La Bosphorus—a historic 1920s tobacco warehouse turned luxury landmark—the hosts witness the literal meeting point of Europe and Asia on the Bosphorus Strait. Guided by local experts, the episode explores the architectural force of the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, reflecting a city reinvented from the Byzantine and Ottoman eras into a modern republic. The exploration moves beneath the streets to the 2,000-year-old Basilica Cistern before emerging into the sensory experience of the Grand Bazaar, the historic center of global trade. The narrative then shifts to modern medical tourism at EsteNove to investigate Istanbul’s role as a global healthcare hub. The journey concludes by blending cultural rituals—from the art of Turkish coffee fortune telling to the 40-layer craftsmanship of baklava—proving that in Istanbul, the past is an active, breathing part of the city's future.

programme.title: LIFE FATHER, LIKE SON
programme.desc: This is the story of two young men whose paths tragically crossed on September 29, 1998 in Houston, Texas. One was a sheriff's deputy while the other, like his father, stayed on the wrong side of the law. The deputy made a routine traffic stop one night that ended with him being brutally shot to death by the other young man, Michael Lopez. Prosecutors argued that 17-year-old Lopez deserved to die, but would the jury agree?

programme.title: BODRUM & CAPPADOCIA: NATURE, RESILIENCE, AND REINVENTION
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey from the ancient seaside ruins of Bodrum to the soaring, hand-carved peaks of Cappadocia to explore how the past finds new purpose in the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins on the Aegean coast in Bodrum, a city where ancient history catches the breeze through 15th-century windmills and the fortress of Bodrum Castle. Guided by local experts, the hosts explore the Myndos Gate, where the armies of Alexander the Great once clashed, and uncover the legacy of Princess Ada, one of the world's earliest female leaders. The episode highlights how these ancient spaces, including the grand marble theater, remain alive today as world-class venues for modern performance. The exploration then crosses east into Cappadocia, a landscape sculpted by fire and wind over millions of years. From the vantage point of a hot air balloon at sunrise, the team witnesses a bird's eye view of the region's famous fairy chimneys before descending into the Ozkonak Underground City—a nine-level subterranean complex built for ancient survival. The journey concludes at the Cappadocia Cave Suites, where the hosts meet the pioneering family who transformed their ancestral cave homes into a global tourism landmark, proving that Türkiye’s story is still being written by the people who walk its ancient paths.

programme.desc: Richard McCoy's profile defies understanding--he is a father, a Sunday school teacher and a decorated war hero. He is also a hijacker, an extortionist and a bank robber. McCoy, alleged to be the true identity of infamous bank robber D.B. Cooper, is arrested and convicted, only to acquire yet another skill: escape artist.

programme.title: THE HEARTBEAT OF DENVERV
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver’s progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

programme.title: SKUNK APE, PASCAGOULA ALIENS, LIZARD MAN
programme.desc: The swamps of the Southeast harbor creatures like Florida’s Skunk Ape, the Lizard Man of Scape Ore Swamp, and tales of the infamous Pascagoula Alien abduction.

programme.title: EVERY PARENT'S NIGHTMARE
programme.desc: This episode recounts a heinous crime that is every parent's nightmare, the death of a child. On an autumn evening in November 1998, a man randomly killed a 9-year-old boy in a public bathroom in southern California. The little boy was only feet away and within earshot of his young cousins, relatives and Mother. The murderer was captured days later as he tried to kill again, prompting a startling courtroom confession and an insanity defense. For his crimes, San Diego County prosecutors argued that he deserved to be put on death row. This episode is the story of the killer's monstrous acts and the prosecution team that fought to bring him to justice.

programme.desc: This episode recounts a heinous crime that is every parent's nightmare, the death of a child. On an autumn evening in November 1998, a man randomly killed a 9-year-old boy in a public bathroom in southern California. The little boy was only feet away and within earshot of his young cousins, relatives and Mother. The murderer was captured days later as he tried to kill again, prompting a startling courtroom confession and an insanity defense. For his crimes, San Diego County prosecutors argued that he deserved to be put on death row. This episode is the story of the killer's monstrous acts and the prosecution team that fought to bring him to justice.

programme.title: THE HEARTBEAT OF DENVERV
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver’s progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

programme.title: ROOTS OF THE ROCKIES
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger dig beneath the postcard-perfect landscapes of Colorado to uncover a narrative of sacred homelands, the untold legacy of Black cowboys, and the rugged survival of mountain pioneers. The journey begins at the confluence of the South Platte River and Cherry Creek—the sacred heart of downtown Denver—where Rick Williams of People of Sacred Land reveals the 11,000-year history of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Ute nations. Facing the 'hard truths' of history, Mayor Mike Johnston discusses the city's commitment to recognition, including the creation of the first American Indian cultural embassy. The exploration continues at the Black American West Museum, where the hosts rediscover the 'lost brand' of the frontier: the Black cowboys and Exodusters who made up one in three cattle drivers in the Old West. Transitioning from the plains to the peaks, the team heads to Telluride and Winter Park to experience the evolution of mountain life. From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

programme.title: GREEN CLAWED BEAST, BIG MUDDY MONSTER, GRASSMAN
programme.desc: A family’s hike turns nightmarish when they encounter the monstrous Grassman, while the Ohio and Big Muddy Rivers are home to the Green Clawed Beast and Big Muddy Monster.

programme.title: THE GREEN WIDOW
programme.desc: The Green Widow focuses on Mary Ellen Samuels, a woman whose lust for money and drugs led her to arrange for the 1988 murder of her husband, a successful Hollywood cameraman. Worried that authorities were catching up to her, she also arranged for the murder of the hitman. Meanwhile, as investigators continued to gather evidence against her, she went on a yearlong, $500,000 shopping spree with the insurance money from her husband’s death. She bought a brand new Porsche and a condo in Cancun, Mexico. With the hit man dead, little forensic evidence, and no eyewitnesses, prosecutors faced an uphill battle in their attempts to secure a double murder conviction against her.

programme.title: KILL SHOT
programme.desc: With time running out, the FBI’s elite Hostage Rescue Team devises a brilliant plan to save a kidnapped woman and her toddler by luring the suspect into a sniper's sights.

programme.title: FLYING HUMANOID, JERSEY DEVIL, BATSQUATCH
programme.desc: Across America, flying monsters like the Flying Humanoid, Batsquatch, and Jersey Devil terrorize communities, leaving towns gripped with fear.

programme.title: LONE WITNESS
programme.desc: Lone Witness is the story of Buffalo, New York gang leader Donald ' Sly' Green and a lone witness to a gangland slaying which helped bring Green to justice. By the fall of 1988, the east side of Buffalo was rapidly becoming a war zone. There was little that authorities could do. Green’s murder of a rival in broad daylight was just another in a string of gang-related killings. But this time there was a witness: James Wright. Armed with the testimony of Wright, who refused to give in to death threats and attacks by Green’s gang, Prosecutor Joseph Marusak put the case before a jury. Green’s conviction would be the first step toward reclaiming the streets of Buffalo from the bands of drug-dealing murderers.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Spend a super fun day with Cody from morning to night! Join Toni and Cody as they bond during a special Hair Wash Day, where they scrub, rinse and comb his perfect curls. Then, Cody dresses up in a safari outfit and leads his Dad on a quest through a jungle-like environment to find dinosaurs! The fun day ends with a silly bedtime routine where his parents make deliberate mistakes, prompting laughs from Cody as he 'corrects' them.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to play JJ's favorite games! Join Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch kids as they play 'follow the leader' and have a contest to see who can make the silliest funny face. Then, JJ and his animal friends have a party where they play freeze dance! The fun continues with vehicles, as Grandpa makes a cool choo-choo train out of cardboard boxes and the kids play with different construction vehicles in a giant sandpit.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: It's a learning dance party with JJ's animal pals! First, learn all about vowels with the fun and silly song 'Apples and Bananas.' Then, get ready to count as you dance with dinosaurs and countdown from five to one. The learning continues as you guess what sounds different animals make and bounce like rabbits, frogs and kangaroos on a trampoline! Plus, you can even learn to sing 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' entirely in Spanish with Nina!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: It's an Artsy August crafting adventure! Help JJ, Kiki, and Emmy make a hot air balloon to chase Boba's lost balloon. Then, unlock a pirate treasure chest, have a dance party on a disco mat, and bake some delicious alphabet cupcakes!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Watch as Buster becomes a real-life superhero! When a storm starts during a nature walk, everyone panics, but it's up to brave Buster to lead them all safely home through the rain and wind. Then, Buster wants to be an emergency vehicle. He gets his chance to be a hero when he's guarding the fire station and a fire breaks out! It's up to Buster the hero fire truck to save the day. From flying like Super Buster to rescuing a kitten, he's always a hero!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Buster is learning, growing and having fun! First, he gets covered in mud and needs to get clean, but he's frightened by the big, noisy carwash! He has to work up the courage to try it himself. Then, after eating too many sweets, Buster gets a sore tooth and Amber the Ambulance teaches him the importance of keeping his teeth clean. In a race against Terry Tractor, Buster also learns that slow and steady can sometimes win the race!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko on his biggest adventures yet, from waterfalls to outer space! First, when Grandma's caravan rolls into a river and heads for a waterfall, Gecko must perform a daring chase to save her! Then, a lovely day at the beach becomes perilous when some vehicles get caught in the tide, requiring a helicopter rescue. The adventure blasts off as the Mechs accidentally launch their homemade spaceship to the moon and need to use solar power to get home!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko and the Mechanicals face a big test of skill and teamwork! First, the Mechs are in Garage School when a real emergency comes in. In a role reversal, they must fix Fiona the Firetruck's starter motor while Gecko instructs them! Then, when Blue crashes during a flying race, Gecko must show his skill to repair him. The day ends with a big American football game where Gecko comes up with a clever strategy and a creative fix to help his team win!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: It's time to sing your favorite songs with JJ and his animal friends! Join JJ as he puts on a performance of 'Old Macdonald,' where each of his animal pals gets to show off their funny sounds on stage. Then, watch as Wally the director puts on a play version of the rhyme 'Hey Diddle Diddle'! The musical fun continues as the friends work together to magically grow jumbo fruit for their smoothie stand and take a wild ride in a submarine they thought was just a toy!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Get crafty this Artsy August! Learn to make a cool paper airplane with YoYo, step-by-step. Then, learn all about shapes, play a fun game of freeze dance with animal friends, and join a sports competition!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: It's time to sing, play and learn with all of JJ's animal pals! The fun begins as JJ hosts a big talent show in the clubhouse where all his friends get to showcase their unique skills, from magic to circus tricks! Then, everyone joins in for a fun game of 'Follow the Leader,' where JJ learns that a little encouragement goes a long way. Plus, sing along as the friends learn all the different sounds the animals make and help Humpty Dumpty when he keeps falling off a wall!

programme.title: CeCe Time
programme.desc: It's CeCe Time, full of kittens, tutus and fun! The big day arrives when CeCe gets her very own adorable kitten! She loves her new friend and wants to put on a show, so she gets in her ballerina outfit to dance for her kitty. Then, after hosting many tea parties for her stuffed animals, CeCe invites her real friends JJ and Bella over for a high tea party! From ice skating with Mom to imagining stick ponies are unicorns, it's always a fun and graceful day with CeCe!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Let's learn how to be healthy with Baby John! He learns all about the bones that make up his body when he visits the doctor and his friend 'Mr. Skeleton'! Then, after tripping and falling while playing soccer, Baby John learns the tough task of tying his own shoelaces! The health lessons continue as Mom and Dad teach him how to properly sneeze into his arm to keep everyone around him from getting sick.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Join Ella for a super fun day at Lellobee City Farm! First, when a nest of baby duck eggs starts to hatch, Ella has to play 'Mummy Duck' to keep all the cute but runaway ducklings together! Then, Rishi organizes all the animals for a friendly game of soccer, where everyone learns each other's animal sounds. The fun day ends with a new arrival, as Ella and Mei find and adopt a stray cat named Bingo, welcoming him to his new home!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of helping each other at Lellobee City Farm! When a mama songbird's eggs are about to hatch, Mei, Ella and Rishi build her a beautiful bird feeding table so she can take care of her new chicks. Then, when Heidi the Horse is feeling down in the dumps, Ella and all the friends put on a show and give her a big group hug to make her feel happy again! The helping continues as everyone learns the importance of sharing their veggies with a visiting gopher.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Find out all the fun ways JJ likes to play! First, join JJ, TomTom and YoYo as they spend the day indoors pretending to be doctors and nurses. Then, the fun continues outside! When the kids get restless at a family barbecue, they play a fun game of 'Simon Says.' On another adventure, experienced scouts TomTom and YoYo take JJ under their wing and show him how to do classic outdoor camping activities. From racing grocery carts to a doggy playdate, JJ loves to play!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Get creative this Artsy August! Join a thrilling balloon boat race on the farm. Then, pretend to be a graceful ballerina, go on a dinosaur adventure, play a game of Simon Says, and have a super fun robot dance party!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: What will JJ learn today? Join him for a week of fun as he learns why each day is special. Then, celebrate Valentine's Day with the Melon Patch kids as they show they care with gifts and kind words. The learning continues as Bella helps teach the class the ASL alphabet and Daniela teaches the differences between the English and Spanish ABCs! From visiting a petting zoo to learning about recycling, there's a new lesson every day!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody as he learns how to be a good brother and a good friend! In a heartwarming moment, Cody finds out he's going to be a big brother. After some initial nerves, he spends a special day with his mama and her baby bump. Then, the big day arrives as the family brings his new sister, Kendi, home! Watch Cody take on his new role, helping Kendi get to sleep and learning to play new games together like bouncing a balloon.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get set for an Artsy August adventure! Race with Mila and Morphle in a hot air balloon against tricky racers. Then, help them find a cure for a sneezing Chroma who is covering the city in paint, and join a wild, musical talent show chase!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues and stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind and has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster and Bubbles builds a rocket to try and reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music and a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing and crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird and Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for sweet dreams and goodnight songs! First, Mia giggles with delight as she gathers four of her favorite stuffed animals into bed with her for a fun game of 'Ten in the Bed.' The bedtime fun continues as Maple and Muffin play a game of 'Five Little Monkeys' during their bubble bath. Then, Grandma Panda helps Mia and Bari embark on a fantastic adventure, building a little rocket out of cushions to go on an adventure to the moon!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join the kids for a day of food, play and learning! First, Grandma Panda bakes some cupcakes while Mia and Bari role-play as bakers in their own pretend kitchen and play a game of pat-a-cake. Then, it's time for a teddy bear's picnic with a whole variety of different tasty treats! The learning continues as Daddy and Twinkle show Max how to say hello with a wave before going into town to wave hello to all their friends. It's a fun-filled, yummy day!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures and sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make along the way! Then, Bunny leads Twinkle on an exciting adventure into the forest to find a mysterious box. After a long day of playing, it's time for some sleepy songs. Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about colors, shapes and numbers with Twinkle! First, learn how to count with Twinkle as she finds five balloons in the colors red, blue, green, yellow and purple! Then, join Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to make sandcastles, learning different shapes like squares, triangles and circles. The learning continues as Twinkle and her friends build and count a beautiful tower of rainbow stones and discover the variety of shapes that clouds can take in the sky!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Learn important lessons this month! Find out how to play safe at school, from not running in the classroom to being careful with scissors. Go on a school trip to a fire station and meet parents who are scientists, vets, and firefighters!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: The charm of cute rabbits is irresistible! An old man raised hundreds of rabbits?! Playful little rabbits are spoiled yet timid! What should beginners pay attention to when raising rabbits?! Shocking! Rabbits can be poisoned by eating carrots?! Rabbits have a very bad temper?! They kick people they don't like?! Crazy about rabbits! Caregivers takes care of the little rabbits "wholeheartedly"?!

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight. Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.
